name: use-is-stuck
description: Is a position: sticky element currently parked at its offset? The state a pinned bar changes appearance on, and the one CSS cannot answer — there is no :stuck. OBSERVED rather than listened for: an IntersectionObserver at threshold 1, with a root margin pulled in by the caller's own sticky offset plus a pixel, rooted at the nearest SCROLLING ancestor rather than the viewport — a bar pinned inside a scrolling panel sits at a fixed viewport position, so a viewport-rooted observer watches it never move and the state never flips. No sentinel node, no scroll listener, and no per-frame getBoundingClientRect, which is a forced synchronous layout on the busiest thread there is. Header's own affix state is the first consumer; Fade's visibility on a pinned bar is the second.
